title: SUMONE: A Simple and Efficient Summarizer for Plug-and-Play Agent Memory
abstract: arXiv:2611.06445v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon language-model agents accumulate increasingly large interaction histories, making context compaction essential for efficient execution. Existing learned compaction methods often rely on downstream task outcomes or solver behavior, coupling training to specific tasks or agents. We introduce SumOne, a standalone summarizer trained to preserve information in agent histories through masked reconstruction. Given a summary of the expired history, a frozen reconstructor recovers randomly masked portions of the original trajectory; reconstruction quality, combined with a length penalty, provides a task-agnostic reward for optimizing the summarizer with GRPO. This yields self-supervision directly from raw trajectories, without reference summaries or downstream task execution. translated_title: SUMONE：一个面向即插即用智能体记忆的简单高效摘要器
translated_abstract: 长时程语言模型智能体会积累日益庞大的交互历史，因此上下文压缩对高效执行至关重要。现有的学习式压缩方法通常依赖下游任务结果或求解器行为，使训练与特定任务或智能体耦合在一起。我们提出了SumOne，一个通过掩码重建来学习保留智能体历史信息的独立摘要器。给定已过期历史的摘要，一个冻结的重建器恢复原始轨迹中被随机掩码的部分；重建质量结合长度惩罚，构成了一个任务无关的奖励信号，用于以GRPO优化摘要器。由此，自监督信号可直接从原始轨迹中获得，无需参考摘要或下游任务执行。在推理时，仅保留轻量级的摘要器，即可为无需改动原有智能体实现即插即用的上下文压缩。我们进行了系统……
tldr: SumOne是一个通过掩码重建进行自监督训练的独立摘要器，无需参考摘要或任务特定信号，即可为长时程智能体提供轻量级、即插即用的上下文压缩。
en_tdlr: SumOne is a standalone summarizer trained through masked-reconstruction self-supervision, enabling task-agnostic, plug-and-play context compression for long-horizon agents without requiring reference summaries or downstream task signals.
